saints.name: Vincent of Saragossa
saints.legacy: Martyrdom and unwavering faith in Christ
saints.summary: Saint Vincent of Saragossa was a deacon and martyr who served in the early Church during the persecution of Diocletian. He was known for his unwavering faith and courage in the face of brutal torture, ultimately dying for his beliefs. His relics are preserved in Lisbon, and he is venerated as a protector of the faithful.
